page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Adversativa. Te verò suasisse, ne emerent.
Ratio continens propositionem: Quia judices nō licere.
Argumentum I. Ab interdicto Dei Deut.7. 25: Sculptilia deorum ipsorum igni comburite, non concupisces aurum & argentum, quæ super ea sunt.
Obiect. Esse hanc legem forensem, Mosaicam.
Respon. Etiam Christianis dicitur: Fugite i-dola.
Argumentum II. à Thesi: Quia res Eccle-siæ publicis usibus semel dicatas, quantum vis su-perstitione inquinatæ sint, in privatos usus con-vertere non liceat.
Probatio Majoris ab authoritate Ambrosii l.2 off. cap. 28. Et Augustini Epistola 154. dicentis, vel in communes usus, vel in honorem Dei veri convertendas esse.
Ratio 1. Quia alioqui non pietate sed avari-tia destrui videtur idololatria.
11. Quia Deus aurum Hierichuntinum ana-thematizatum non diripi, sed in suos thesauros inferri voluit.
Argumentum III. à pari: Quia non licet vesci Idolothytis. 1.Cor.8.
Argumentum IV. ab adiuncto: Quia hoc est communicare rapinis. Amplificetur minor ex eo quod viliter vendunt.
Conclusio: Petere igitur te amici judicium.

page.notes: Doubtful reading: "Nesis" in the line "11. Nesis abominatio sicut illud." The long s and the f are hard to tell apart at this scan resolution. The catchword "Respon-" is set large at the lower right, below the last full line. The paragraph beginning "Adversativa." may continue an argument from the previous page, but its opening is not clear enough to mark it as a continuation.
